# axiz-adapter-crypto-jose

JWS and JWE utilities.

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-adapter-crypto-jose</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Jose` | JWS and JWE utilities with a fixed allow-list of algorithms: PS256, RS256 and ES256 for signatures; RSA-OAEP-256 with A256GCM for encryption. |

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl adapters/axiz-adapter-crypto-jose verify`.
